title: Custom text value for `st.chat_input`
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

I propose to add a parameter to `st.chat_input` that allows for the customization of the user prompt, similar to the `value` parameter of `st.text_input`. 

### Why?

I have been working on an LLM that is built on top of ChatGPT. On the App page, there's a dropdown of prompt examples that users can choose from, and once they select a prompt, it should automatically appear in the `st.chat_input` box (similar to the prompt examples ChatGPT provides). Unfortunately, there is currently no way to set a custom prompt for `st.chat_input`. As this is a common practice for UIs of chat models, this functionality could be extremely helpful for a lot of applications.

### How?

I currently don't have much time to understand the details of `st.chat_input`'s implementation, but I suppose it is at least somewhat similar to how `st.text_input` is implemented. I think the team can look into how the `value` parameter is handled in `st.text_input` and use it as a reference for this functionality.

### Additional Context

_No response_

```python
def floating_bar(model, answer_container, message_status_lis):
    # 模型与功能
    qa_audio_bytes = ""
    qa_status = False
    user_query = None
    stream_answer = []
    stand_callback=None
    warning_info=""
    # 带有展开/折叠按钮的容器
    chat_input_container = st.container()
    with chat_input_container:
        if st.session_state.manage_message:  # 管理消息
            cols2 = st.columns([0.3, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3])
            if cols2[1].button("删除", type="primary", key="del_message"):
                # print(f"message_status_lis： {message_status_lis}")
                messages = [message for is_del, message in zip(message_status_lis, st.session_state.messages) if not is_del]
                st.session_state.messages = messages
                st.session_state.manage_message = False  # 是否管理历史记录
                st.rerun()
            if cols2[2].button("返回", type="primary", key="back_to_chat"):
                st.session_state.manage_message = False  # 是否管理历史记录
                st.rerun()

        else:
            cols1 = st.columns([0.1, 0.9, 0.1, 0.1])
            cols1[0].button(":<nick>:", on_click=lambda: st.session_state.messages.clear())
            if user_query2 := cols1[1].chat_input(placeholder="请输入内容..."):
                user_query = user_query2
                qa_status = True
            with cols1[2]:
                qa_audio_bytes = audio_recorder(text="", icon_size="2x", key=st.session_state.qa_audio_key)
            if cols1[3].button("译", help="将最新一条翻译为中文，非正式功能，仅用作测试"):
                qa_status = True
                user_query = "翻译为中文"
    if qa_audio_bytes:
        # user_query, is_success = audio2text(qa_audio_bytes, from_language=st.session_state.language)
        # 存储成文件，翻译，删除文件
        temp_path = get_audio_path(event_id="temp", audio_md5=str2md5(qa_audio_bytes))
        save_audio(audio=qa_audio_bytes, f_path=temp_path)
        with open(temp_path, "rb") as qa_audio_f:
            user_query, is_success = audio2text(qa_audio_f, from_language=st.session_state.language)
        logger.info(f"删除临时语音文件：{temp_path}")
        os.remove(temp_path)

        st.session_state.qa_audio_key = random.randint(1000, 100000000)
        logger.info(f"is_success: {is_success}, user_query: {user_query}")
        if is_success:
            qa_status = True
        else:
            with answer_container:
                st.error("音频识别失败，请重新录音!")
    # floating_audio_bar()
    chat_input_css = float_css_helper(bottom="1rem", display="flex", justify_content="center", margin="0 auto", max_width="800px")
    # Float button container
    chat_input_container.float(chat_input_css)

    if qa_status:
        user_query, stream_answer, warning_info = run_llm_chat(user_query, 
            history_message=st.session_state.messages, 
            event_info_lis=st.session_state.event_info_lis, 
            model=model,
            language=st.session_state.language)
        with answer_container:
            stream_chat(user_query=user_query, stream_answer=stream_answer, stand_callback=stand_callback, warning_info=warning_info)
            status = False
```


这是这块的实现的方法，你可以参考一下，主要思路是使用“streamlit_float”构建一个悬浮在底部的悬浮框，在悬浮框内使用column构建横排的按钮和输入框。需要注意一下streamlit的版本，低版本貌似会有些问题。

> js = f"""
>     <script>
>         function insertText(dummy_var_to_force_repeat_execution) {{
>             var chatInput = parent.document.querySelector('textarea[data-testid="stChatInput"]');
>             var nativeInputValueSetter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, "value").set;
>             nativeInputValueSetter.call(chatInput, "{default_chat_input_value}");
>             var event = new Event('input', {{ bubbles: true}});
>             chatInput.dispatchEvent(event);
>         }}
>         insertText({len(st.session_state.messages)});
>     </script>
>     """
> st.components.v1.html(js)

I noticed that if the js doesn't change, the **next** `rerun()` won't execute the js. Probably due to cache mechanism. The workaround is to create a random string within the `<script>` to bypass the cache and force the script execution everytime `rerun()` takes place. A random string within the script can be `let x = "{datetime.now}";`.
